RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; public sector panel compositions typically reflect internal seniority, availability, or scheduling rather than prejudice. Furthermore, the successful candidate has strong, relevant credentials, including an advanced degree and international project leadership experience. 

A two-week delay for written feedback is standard bureaucratic lag in government recruitment, not an indication of bad faith or evasion. Raising sex discrimination without concrete evidence—such as documented procedural irregularities or biased interview remarks—is unsubstantiated and could severely harm your professional reputation and career within the civil service. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback and use it constructively for future promotional opportunities.
